# journal entry postings

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:journalEntryPostings`](gmeow-journalEntryPostings.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/journalEntryPostings>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The postings that compose a journal entry. Non-functional: a journal entry has at least two postings (SHACL-enforced).
